title: Learning Object-Centric Spatial Reasoning for Sequential Manipulation in Cluttered Environments
abstract: arXiv:2603.02511v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Sequential manipulation in clutter requires selecting which objects to remove and determining how to manipulate them. Learning both decisions jointly can complicate training and make failures difficult to diagnose. We present Unveiler, a modular framework that separates scene reasoning and object selection from action execution through a discrete object-index interface. Its Spatial Relationship Encoder (SRE) selects the best object to grasp, while a separate Action Decoder generates orientation-discretized push-grasp actions. The SRE is trained in two stages: imitation learning from heuristic demonstrations, followed by search-based policy improvement using simulated object removals. This training procedure requires no real-robot training data and allows the SRE to be paired with a different execution policy. translated_title: 面向杂乱环境中顺序操作的以对象为中心的空间推理学习
translated_abstract: 在杂乱环境中进行顺序操作需要选择移除哪些物体并确定如何操作它们。联合学习这两个决策会使训练复杂化，并使失败难以诊断。我们提出了Unveiler，一个模块化框架，它通过离散的对象索引接口将场景推理和对象选择与动作执行分离。其空间关系编码器（SRE）选择最佳的抓取对象，而独立的动作解码器生成方向离散化的推-抓动作。SRE分两个阶段进行训练：首先从启发式示范中进行模仿学习，随后利用模拟的物体移除进行基于搜索的策略改进。这种训练过程不需要真实机器人训练数据，并允许SRE与不同的执行策略配对使用。我们在PyBullet仿真和实体Dofbot-Pro机器人上对Unveiler进行了评估。在真实机器人实验中，它成功取出了两个被遮挡……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出模块化框架Unveiler，将场景推理与物体选择（通过空间关系编码器）和动作执行相分离，无需真实机器人训练数据即可在杂乱环境中实现顺序操作任务。
